text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: INCIDENT: scale-controller-queue-backlog on inference-api-prod — severity: P1 — queued_requests > 10k across worker-pool, reconciliation lag > 2m. Link: https://pagerduty.example/INC12345 :rotating_light: Grafana: https://grafana.example/d/abc/queue-metrics

pagerduty: Incident created and notifications sent to on-call.

marie_oncall: ack — I'm on it, moving to quick triage. Any customer reports yet?

jess: seeing spike in 5xx/429s at the edge. traces show tokenizers hot and worker-pool CPU pegged. quick log snippet: `scale-controller: reconcile took 130s, pendingReplicas=0 -> desired=12` — autoscaler isn't applying changes.

sahil: are we hitting maxReplicas or cloud quota? HPA is min=2 max=10 in cluster config.

marie_oncall: running checks now. `kubectl -n inference get hpa scale-controller -o yaml` -> desiredReplicas: 8, currentReplicas: 2, metrics: queue_length=12000.

marie_oncall: controller logs show repeated backoffs: `rate_limit_exceeded patching deployment` and `reconcile backoff=30s`.

platform-sre: looks like control-plane API throttling in us-west-2 — we've seen this when many PATCHes happen at once. will verify cloud quota.

jess: customer impact: intermittent 503s and elevated latency for some tenants — error rate ~6% and rising.

marie_oncall: mitigation plan: 1) temporarily increase maxReplicas to 20; 2) manually scale worker-pool to 12 while controller recovers; 3) apply conservative rate-limit to non-critical traffic. executing step 2 now.

marie_oncall: `kubectl -n inference scale deploy/worker-pool --replicas=12` -> scaled. pods starting.

ops-rotations: @marie_oncall do you have permission to bump cloud quotas if needed? we may need platform help for that.

platform-sre: opening support ticket for API quota. meanwhile I can nudge controller config to reduce backoff. will also grant a short-lived quota bump if support approves.

jess: applied temporary rate-limit via feature-flag: `ffctl set inference_ingress_noncritical_rate 20` — verified on prod. non-critical traffic is throttled.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: acknowledged by marie_oncall.

pagerduty: If no acknowledgement in 10m, escalate to sahil.

sahil: standing by to take over in 10-15. monitoring queue. currently queue trending down 12k -> 4k. controller still logging throttled reconciles.

platform-sre: cloud support replied: elevated API burst quota for 1 hour; controller able to PATCH again. I triggered a manual reconcile: `kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/scale-controller`. logs show reconciling and desiredReplicas -> 18.

marie_oncall: manual reconcile succeeded, HPA currentReplicas=18, new pods becoming Ready. queue length 600 and falling. errors down to ~1%.

jess: status update posted to status page: "Degraded — high request latency for inference-api; mitigation in progress." Notified two affected tenants (st-231, enterprise-beta).

marie_oncall: handing off to @sahil — notes: worker-pool manually scaled, rate-limit in place for noncritical; created GH issue infra/scale-controller#342 with logs and suggested fixes (retry/backoff, circuit-breaker). platform-sre assigned.

sahil: ack. I'll monitor for 30m and coordinate postmortem. will close PD when stable.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: Incident resolved by sahil — condition cleared.

pagerduty: Incident resolved. Summary: control-plane API throttling prevented autoscaler/controller from reconciling; temporary manual scaling + rate-limiting + cloud quota bump cleared backlog. Followups: harden controller retries, add circuit-breaker for PATCHes, increase observable alerts for reconciliation lag.

jess: thanks team. filing blameless postmortem and scheduling follow-up with platform-sre. :white_check_mark:
